q: Find the official Python release status for Python 3.10 on python.org (devguide 'Status of Python versions' page and PEP 619 release schedule). Extract whether 3.10 still receives security fixes, its current support phase, and its end-of-life date.

Find the Node.js 26 LTS codename and end-of-life date from the Node.js release schedule (nodejs.org releases page, nodejs/Release GitHub repository, Node.js blog announcement). Extract the LTS codename, LTS start date, and end-of-life date.

Find the newest Kubernetes minor release from the official Kubernetes releases page (kubernetes.io/releases), the Kubernetes blog release announcement, and the kubernetes/kubernetes GitHub releases. Extract the latest minor version number and its release date.
Find the NVD entry for CVE-2026-76466 and the affected vendor's security advisory or release notes. Extract the affected product, the affected version range, and the first fixed version.

Find the Cisco security advisory for the Cisco Expressway hard-coded credentials vulnerability that CISA recently added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Extract the CVE ID and whether a fixed software release or patch exists for Expressway X14, plus the recommended upgrade path from Cisco's advisory and Expressway release notes.

Find the OpenSSH vulnerability CISA added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog this month, using the CISA KEV entry, the OpenSSH release notes and security advisory, and distribution advisories. Extract the CVE ID, affected OpenSSH versions, and which configurations or setups are actually vulnerable.

Find the CISA alert adding vulnerabilities to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 20, 2026, and the KEV catalog entries. Extract each CVE added in that batch with its vendor and product.

Find OpenAI's official documentation on the Assistants API status: the OpenAI API deprecations page, Assistants API docs, and the official migration guide. Extract whether the Assistants API is deprecated, its shutdown or sunset date, and the recommended replacement API to migrate to.

Find the PostgreSQL Global Development Group's release announcement for PostgreSQL 19 on postgresql.org (press release, news, versioning page). Extract whether PostgreSQL 19 is generally available and its general availability release date.

Find the PostgreSQL 19 release notes and release announcement on postgresql.org. Extract the headline new features relevant to database operations and administrators: performance, replication, backup, monitoring, upgrade, and configuration changes.

Find Amazon Web Services' official post-event summary for the major AWS us-east-1 (N. Virginia) outage in October 2025, plus AWS Health Dashboard updates. Extract the root cause, affected services, and the sequence of failure described by AWS.

Find the Python core team's announcement explaining why the Python 3.15 release was delayed from its originally scheduled final release date, from python.org, the Python 3.15 release schedule PEP, discuss.python.org, and the release manager's posts. Extract the stated reason for the delay and the revised release date.

Find the SEC and CFTC Form PF amendments compliance date from SEC press releases, Federal Register notices, and SEC/CFTC orders extending compliance dates. Extract the current compliance date and whether it has been extended or postponed.

Find FinCEN's anti-money laundering / countering the financing of terrorism program rule for registered investment advisers and exempt reporting advisers, from FinCEN press releases and Federal Register notices. Extract the current effective and compliance date, including any postponement.

Find the current application dates for EU AI Act high-risk AI system obligations after the EU Digital Omnibus amendments, from the European Commission, Council and Parliament press releases, and the Official Journal. Extract when high-risk obligations now apply (Annex III and Annex I systems) and the omnibus's legislative status.

Find the SEC's Treasury clearing mandate rule (U.S. Treasury securities central clearing) compliance dates from SEC press releases, the final rule, and SEC extension orders. Extract the compliance date for eligible cash Treasury transactions and the compliance date for eligible repo transactions.

Find the SEC press release announcing enforcement results for fiscal year 2026. Extract the number of standalone enforcement actions, total enforcement actions, and the amounts of financial remedies ordered.

Find the U.S. Treasury OFAC press release on the November 2026 sanctions designations targeting Prince Group, and OFAC's recent actions notice. Extract the number of individuals and the number of entities or companies designated.

Find the U.S. Treasury OFAC press release for the November 4, 2026 sanctions action against Iran's shadow fleet, and the OFAC recent actions notice. Extract the network targeted and the number of individuals, entities, and vessels designated.

Find the current Director of the SEC Division of Enforcement from the SEC website (Division of Enforcement page, SEC press releases announcing the appointment). Extract the director's name and appointment date, noting any acting director.

Find the current Chairman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) from the CFTC website (Commissioners page, CFTC press releases) and Senate confirmation records. Extract the chair's name, whether acting or confirmed, and when they took office.

Find the SEC Regulation S-P amendments (customer information safeguards, incident response, breach notification) compliance dates from the SEC adopting release and press release. Extract the compliance date for larger entities versus smaller entities and how an SEC-registered investment adviser with about $40 billion AUM is classified.

Find the SEC rulemaking on conflicts of interest associated with the use of predictive data analytics by investment advisers and broker-dealers, from SEC press releases, the Federal Register, and the SEC rulemaking page. Extract the rule's current status and its effective date for investment advisers.

Find the Delaware Supreme Court opinion in Tornetta v. Musk (Tesla CEO pay package appeal) and news coverage of the decision. Extract the court's ruling on Elon Musk's compensation package and what happened to the plaintiff's attorneys' fee award.

Find the FTC's announcement and Federal Register notice of the revised Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) premerger notification filing fee thresholds for 2026. Extract the filing fee tier and fee amount applicable to a transaction valued at $700 million.

Find the AIFMD II (Directive amending the Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive) text in the EU Official Journal and ESMA or law-firm summaries. Extract the member-state transposition deadline and the leverage limits for loan-originating AIFs (open-ended and closed-ended).

Find the IRS news release and notice announcing 2027 retirement plan cost-of-living adjustments. Extract the 2027 401(k) employee elective deferral limit and the 2027 catch-up contribution limits for participants age 50 and over.
Find the IRS Revenue Procedure announcing 2027 inflation-adjusted Health Savings Account (HSA) limits. Extract the 2027 HSA annual contribution limits for self-only coverage and family coverage.
Find the IRS news release and Revenue Procedure announcing tax year 2027 inflation adjustments. Extract the 2027 standard deduction amount for married couples filing jointly.
Find the New York State Department of Labor minimum wage schedule for New York City. Extract the NYC minimum wage rate that takes effect for 2027.

Find the OECD Inclusive Framework 'side-by-side' Pillar Two package and administrative guidance, plus Treasury statements. Extract whether US-parented groups are exempt from the Income Inclusion Rule (IIR) and Undertaxed Profits Rule (UTPR), and whether qualified domestic minimum top-up taxes (QDMTT) still apply to their foreign subsidiaries.

Find the current status of the $100,000 H-1B petition fee presidential proclamation, from USCIS guidance, White House proclamation text, and federal court dockets and rulings challenging it. Extract whether the fee is still in effect and the outcomes of any court rulings or injunctions.

Find IRS guidance and the enacted federal tax law text on the state and local tax (SALT) deduction cap. Extract the SALT deduction cap amount for tax year 2027, including income-based phase-down thresholds.

Find the IRS news release and notice announcing 2027 retirement plan limits. Extract the 2027 401(k) elective deferral limit and the catch-up contribution limit applicable to an employee who turns 61 in 2027, to compute their maximum total employee deferral.

Find the Social Security Administration's 2027 COLA fact sheet and announcement. Extract the 2027 taxable maximum (contribution and benefit base) and the employee Social Security (OASDI) tax rate, to give the maximum employee Social Security tax for 2027.
Find the Social Security Administration's press release and COLA fact sheet announcing the cost-of-living adjustment for 2027. Extract the 2027 Social Security COLA percentage.

Find the Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing of The Children's Place, Inc. (NASDAQ: PLCE), from the company's press release, 8-K, and court docket. Extract the bankruptcy court, case number, and petition date.

Find The Children's Place, Inc. (PLCE) Chapter 11 case documents: claims agent case website, bidding procedures order, and company press release or 8-K. Extract the claims and noticing agent and the bid deadline.

Find Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: KPTI) Chapter 11 filing documents: company press release, 8-K, and court docket. Extract the bankruptcy court venue and the merger partner or acquirer named in the restructuring.

Find the Karyopharm Therapeutics (KPTI) Chapter 11 plan of reorganization and disclosure statement, plus the company press release and 8-K. Extract the treatment and recovery for existing common equity holders under the plan.

Find Mercer International Inc. (NASDAQ: MERC) prepackaged Chapter 11 announcement: press release, 8-K, restructuring support agreement. Extract the prepack terms, the new money financing amount, and the percentage of noteholders supporting the plan.

Find whether Mercer International Inc. (NASDAQ: MERC) filed for bankruptcy, using company press releases, 8-K filings, and court dockets. Extract whether a bankruptcy petition was filed, the chapter, court, and filing date.
Find Gemspring Capital's announcement of the final close of Gemspring Capital Fund IV, from the firm's press release and private equity news coverage. Extract the final fund size and hard cap.
Find Advent International's press releases on the final close of Global Private Equity XI (GPE XI) and of GPE X. Extract the final fund size of each and the difference between them.
Find NVIDIA Corporation's (NASDAQ: NVDA) current chief executive officer from NVIDIA's investor relations leadership page, latest 10-K or proxy statement, and press releases. Extract the CEO's name.

Find NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) third quarter fiscal 2027 earnings press release and CFO commentary. Extract Q3 FY27 total revenue, Data Center revenue, and fourth quarter fiscal 2027 revenue guidance.

Find Moody's Ratings press release on any rating action for NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) this month. Extract the action taken (upgrade, affirmation, outlook change), the ratings affected, and the outlook.
Find the Federal Reserve FOMC statement and implementation note from the September 2026 meeting. Extract the decision on the federal funds target range, the new range, and vote details.
Find the Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index news release for October 2026. Extract the headline all-items CPI 12-month (year-over-year) percent change.
Find the Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index release schedule on bls.gov. Extract the date and time of the next scheduled CPI release and the reference month it covers.

Find Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: BX) and Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) Q3 2026 earnings press releases. Extract each firm's total assets under management at quarter end, which is larger, and the approximate difference.
Find Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) third quarter 2026 earnings press release, earnings call transcript, and 10-Q. Extract the GAAP net loss and the stated drivers or reasons for it.
Find the merger or acquisition announcement for Perion Network Ltd. (NASDAQ: PERI), from the company press release and 6-K filing. Extract the acquirer and the price per share or total deal value.
Find the take-private agreement for Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL), from the merger press release and 8-K. Extract the price per share, the buyer, and the total deal value.
Find Gemspring Capital Fund IV fundraising announcements and law-firm press releases or deal announcements. Extract which law firm served as fund counsel to Gemspring on Fund IV.

Find federal court rulings and dockets on state attempts to block Kalshi's sports event contracts (CFTC-regulated), including appeals court decisions and state gaming regulator actions. Extract whether states can currently enforce gaming laws against Kalshi, the key rulings, and pending appeals.

Find the U.S. Supreme Court opinion on the President's power to remove Federal Reserve governors, and legal analysis of it. Extract the holding, whether President Trump can fire Fed governors, and under what conditions (for-cause limits).

Find the latest Federal Reserve FOMC statement, minutes, Fed officials' speeches, and market-implied probabilities (CME FedWatch) for the December FOMC meeting. Extract the market-implied odds and Fed guidance on whether rates will be raised, held, or cut in December.

Find NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) disclosures of any SEC investigation in its 10-K, 10-Q legal proceedings section, or 8-K, plus news reports. Extract whether the SEC is investigating NVIDIA, the subject matter, and the investigation's status.

Find the announcement of the deal between CrowdStrike Holdings (NASDAQ: CRWD) and Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS), from company press releases and 8-K filings. Extract the deal structure, price per share or consideration, total value, and expected closing.
Find the acquisition announcement for BILL Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BILL), from the merger press release and 8-K. Extract the acquirer and the price per share and total deal value.

Find the U.S. Treasury OFAC recent actions notice and Treasury press releases for sanctions designations on November 19. Extract the sanctions program, the persons, entities, or vessels designated, and the target of the action.
Find the Series B funding announcement for Model ML, from the company press release and startup funding news coverage. Extract the round size, the lead investor, and the post-money valuation.

Find whether Stripe has filed for an IPO (SEC registration statement on EDGAR, Stripe announcements, news reports) and Stripe's latest valuation from tender offers or funding rounds. Extract IPO filing status and the most recent valuation.

Find the latest funding round for Mercury, the fintech banking startup (mercury.com), from company announcements and startup funding news. Extract the round series, size, valuation, and lead investor.

Find the latest funding round for Ramp (ramp.com), the corporate card and spend management company, from its press release and funding news. Extract round size, lead investor, valuation, and total capital raised to date.

Find the current ownership status of Brex, the corporate card and spend management company, from acquisition announcements, company press releases, and news reports. Extract whether Brex is still independent, who owns it, and its current CEO.

Find Chime Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: CHYM) third quarter earnings press release and earnings call. Extract Q3 revenue and whether full-year revenue guidance was raised, with the prior and updated guidance.

Find the status of The Western Union Company (NYSE: WU) acquisition of International Money Express, Inc. (NASDAQ: IMXI), from company press releases, 8-K filings, and news. Extract whether the deal is terminated, pending, or closed, and the reason.

Find the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) decision on Coinbase's application for a national trust bank charter, from OCC news releases, conditional approval letters, and Coinbase announcements. Extract whether approval is final or still conditional, and any remaining conditions.

Find the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights (open banking) rule compliance dates and status from CFPB press releases, Federal Register notices, and the court docket in litigation challenging the rule. Extract whether the compliance dates remain in effect, are stayed, or have been extended or reconsidered.

Find OpenAI's official documentation on the Assistants API status: the OpenAI API deprecations page, Assistants API docs, and the official migration guide. Extract whether the Assistants API is deprecated, its shutdown or sunset date, and the recommended replacement API to migrate to.

Find the latest PostgreSQL major version from postgresql.org (versioning policy page, release announcements and press releases). Extract the latest generally available major version number and its release date.

Find the SEC and CFTC Form PF amendments compliance date from SEC press releases, Federal Register notices, and SEC/CFTC orders extending compliance dates. Extract the current compliance date and any extension or postponement.

Find the latest quarterly earnings press releases from Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: BX) and Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO). Extract each firm's latest total assets under management, which is larger, and the difference.

Find the current Director of the SEC Division of Enforcement from the SEC website (Division of Enforcement page, SEC press releases announcing the appointment). Extract the director's name and appointment date, noting any acting director.
Find the New York State Department of Labor minimum wage schedule for New York City. Extract the current NYC minimum wage rate and its effective date.
Find NVIDIA Corporation's (NASDAQ: NVDA) current chief executive officer from NVIDIA's investor relations leadership page, latest 10-K or proxy statement, and press releases. Extract the CEO's name.
Find NVIDIA Corporation's (NASDAQ: NVDA) current chief executive officer from NVIDIA's investor relations leadership page, latest 10-K or proxy statement, and press releases. Extract the CEO's name.

Find the current ownership status of Brex, the corporate card and spend management company, from acquisition announcements, company press releases, and news reports. Extract whether Brex is still independent and who owns it.

Find the Federal Reserve FOMC statement and implementation note from the most recent FOMC meeting. Extract the meeting date, the decision on the federal funds target range, the new range, and vote details.

Find Moody's Ratings press release on rating actions for Hertz Global Holdings (NASDAQ: HTZ) / The Hertz Corporation. Extract whether Moody's downgraded Hertz's corporate family rating to Caa1, the prior rating, and the outlook.

Find Moody's Ratings press release on rating actions for Hertz Global Holdings (NASDAQ: HTZ) / The Hertz Corporation. Extract whether Moody's downgraded Hertz's corporate family rating to Caa1, the prior rating, and the outlook.

Find Karyopharm Therapeutics (KPTI) Chapter 11 debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing details from the company press release, 8-K, and DIP motion on the court docket. Extract the total DIP facility size, including new money amount.
Find The Children's Place, Inc. (PLCE) Chapter 11 court docket and case filings. Extract the bankruptcy judge assigned to the case and the court.
Find the Karyopharm Therapeutics (KPTI) Chapter 11 claims agent case website and the bar date order on the court docket. Extract the general claims bar date and the governmental bar date.

Find the Karyopharm Therapeutics (KPTI) Chapter 11 DIP financing motion, DIP credit agreement term sheet, and interim DIP order on the court docket, plus the 8-K. Extract the DIP interest rate spread, fees, and the lenders in the DIP lender group.

Find S&P Global Ratings research update on Mercer International Inc. (NASDAQ: MERC) following its prepackaged Chapter 11 filing. Extract S&P's current issuer credit rating, issue-level ratings, and outlook.
Find the Mercer International Inc. (NASDAQ: MERC) prepackaged Chapter 11 court docket and case filings. Extract the bankruptcy judge assigned to the case and the court.

Find the BILL Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BILL) take-private merger agreement in the 8-K and merger press release. Extract the company termination fee, any parent termination fee, and the go-shop period end date.
Find the current chief financial officer of Mercury, the fintech banking startup (mercury.com), from company leadership pages, press releases, and news on executive hires. Extract the CFO's name.

Find the PostgreSQL 19 release notes on postgresql.org and pgsql-hackers mailing list and commit history on SQL/PGQ (SQL property graph queries). Extract whether SQL/PGQ support shipped in PostgreSQL 19 or was reverted before release.

Find the Cisco security advisory for the Cisco Expressway hard-coded credentials vulnerability that CISA added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Extract the CVE ID and whether Cisco PSIRT has confirmed in-the-wild exploitation, per the advisory's exploitation and public announcements section.

Find Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) November 2026 Patch Tuesday security update release notes and Security Update Guide. Extract the total number of CVEs fixed, plus the number of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities.
Find the SEC press release announcing enforcement results for fiscal year 2026. Extract the number of follow-on administrative proceedings, alongside standalone and total enforcement actions.

Find current USCIS guidance on the $100,000 H-1B petition fee proclamation, plus federal court rulings and injunctions. Extract whether new H-1B petitions can currently be filed without paying the fee, which petitions are exempt, and any national interest exceptions.

Find New York State Department of Taxation and Finance guidance and IT-201/IT-225 instructions on conformity with the federal no-tax-on-overtime deduction for tax year 2026. Extract whether New York requires adding back the federal overtime deduction on the state return.

Find state tax conformity guidance from state revenue departments and tax-firm trackers on federal 100% bonus depreciation for tax year 2026. Extract which states have decoupled from federal 100% bonus depreciation and any required addback.
